subject: DI04000241

body.en:
Start with the situation

A hardened shaft may already have its shape but still need a precise bearing seat and controlled finish.

Definition / principle

Grinding removes material with a bonded abrasive wheel whose many grains act as small cutting edges.

Understand why

Individual grain geometry is irregular; cutting, rubbing and ploughing generate heat that can damage the surface.

Application / illustration

Suitable grinding can finish hard materials and accurate surfaces, but it is not automatically the best bulk-removal choice.

Common mistake / conditions

Wheel strength, speed rating, guarding and trained setup are safety-critical; do not treat a wheel as an ordinary steel cutter.

Can truing replace balancing?

No. Geometry correction and mass-balance correction solve different problems.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Hardened shaftનો shape તૈયાર હોય,પણ precise bearing seat,controlled finish હજી જોઈએ.

Definition / Principle

Grindingમાં bonded abrasive wheelના અનેક grains નાના cutting edges બની material દૂર કરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Grain geometry irregular હોય;cutting,rubbing,ploughing heat બનાવે,જે surface damage કરી શકે.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Suitable grinding hard material,accurate surfaces finish કરે,પણ bulk removal માટે હંમેશાં best નહિ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Wheel strength,speed rating,guarding,trained setup safety-critical છે;wheelને ordinary steel cutter ન માનો.

Truing,Balancingનો Substitute છે?

ના.Geometry correction,mass-balance correction જુદા problems ઉકેલે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Distinguish the generated surface and the workholding arrangement.

Understand why

Surface grinding makes planes using wheel periphery or face with suitable reciprocating/rotary tables.

Cylindrical grinding machines external round surfaces; internal grinding finishes bores.

Centreless grinding supports work on a blade between grinding and regulating wheels rather than between centres.

Tool-and-cutter grinders restore tool geometry; bench/pedestal grinders serve suitable general tool work under guarded procedures.

Through-feed, infeed and end-feed are centreless variants; shouldered work cannot always pass through freely.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Generated surface,workholding arrangement જુદાં ઓળખો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Surface grindingમાં wheel periphery/faceથી suitable reciprocating/rotary table પર planes બને.

Cylindrical grinding external round surface;internal grinding bores finish કરે.

Centrelessમાં centresની જગ્યાએ grinding/regulating wheels વચ્ચે blade પર work support થાય.

Tool-and-cutter grinder tool geometry restore કરે;bench/pedestal guarded procedureમાં general tool work કરે.

Through-feed,infeed,end-feed centreless variants છે;shouldered work હંમેશાં freely through-feed નહિ થઈ શકે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Wheel periphery removes small layers while a supported table traverses under it.

Construction:part and purpose

Base and column provide stable references and vibration-resistant support.

Wheelhead contains spindle, bearings and approved wheel mounting.

The guarded wheel presents abrasive edges at the working zone.

Longitudinal table motion traverses the work beneath the wheel.

Cross-feed and vertical downfeed position successive passes/layers.

Magnetic chuck or suitable alternative fixture holds the work according to material/geometry.

Dressing, coolant/filtration and control systems support consistent cutting and thermal control.

Working:flow and reason

Confirm suitable work material, datum and approved holding arrangement.

Use an authorised checked wheel/setup within machine and wheel ratings.

Wheel rotation supplies abrasive cutting speed.

Table traverse passes the clamped work beneath the engagement zone.

Cross-feed moves the next strip under the wheel.

Controlled downfeed removes successive small layers while thermal condition is monitored.

Stop safely for dimensional/finish checks and any approved redressing or adjustment.

Common mistake / conditions

A magnetic chuck does not grip non-ferromagnetic work reliably by itself; small/thin work needs an approved secure arrangement.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Supported table નીચે traverse થાય ત્યારે wheel periphery નાનાં layers દૂર કરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Base,column stable reference,vibration-resistant support આપે.

Wheelhead spindle,bearings,approved wheel mounting રાખે.

Guarded wheel working zoneમાં abrasive edges આપે.

Longitudinal table workને wheel નીચે traverse કરે.

Cross-feed,vertical downfeed successive passes/layers position કરે.

Material/geometry મુજબ magnetic chuck કે alternative fixture work પકડે.

Dressing,coolant/filtration,controls cutting consistency,thermal controlમાં મદદ કરે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Suitable material,datum,approved holding confirm કરો.

Machine,wheel ratingsમાં authorised checked wheel/setup લો.

Wheel rotation abrasive cutting speed આપે.

Table traverse clamped workને engagement zone નીચે પસાર કરે.

Cross-feed next stripને wheel નીચે લાવે.

Controlled downfeed નાનાં layers દૂર કરે,thermal condition monitor થાય.

Dimensions/finish check,approved redressing/adjustment માટે safely stop કરો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Magnetic chuck એકલું non-ferromagnetic work reliable રીતે પકડતું નથી;small/thin workમાં approved secure arrangement જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A rotating cylindrical workpiece is ground by a separate rotating abrasive wheel.

Construction:part and purpose

Bed and table establish the work-axis reference and traverse.

Workhead drives the job through approved holding or centre-drive arrangements.

Tailstock/centres support suitable work on its axis.

Wheelhead carries the guarded grinding wheel and its drive.

Radial infeed establishes stock removal; table traverse covers work length where used.

Rests or special fixtures support slender or awkward work as specified.

Dresser, coolant filtration, controls and gauges support accuracy and surface integrity.

Working:flow and reason

Locate/support work so the required cylindrical datum is preserved.

The workhead rotates the work at its own selected speed.

The wheel rotates independently at approved surface speed.

Controlled radial approach establishes grinding engagement.

In traverse grinding, the table moves work axially past the wheel.

In suitable plunge grinding, a shaped/wide wheel feeds radially over the feature.

Gauge after safe stopping or with an approved in-process system; check taper, roundness and thermal effects.

Common mistake / conditions

Sample capacity:diameter200mm, length500mm; surface-grinder sample table600×200mm. These are illustrative, not actual lab specifications.

Specified rests/fixtures slender/awkward work support કરે.

Dresser,coolant filtration,controls,gauges accuracy,surface integrityમાં મદદ કરે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Required cylindrical datum જળવાય તે રીતે work locate/support કરો.

Workhead selected speedથી work ફેરવે.

Controlled radial approach grinding engagement આપે.

Traverse grindingમાં table workને axially wheel પાસેથી ખસેડે.

Suitable plunge grindingમાં shaped/wide wheel feature પર radially feed થાય.

Safe stop પછી કે approved in-process systemથી gauge કરો;taper,roundness,thermal effects જુઓ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Sample cylindrical capacity diameter200mm,length500mm;surface grinder table600×200mm.આ illustrative છે,actual lab specification નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A work-rest blade and regulating wheel control a workpiece against the high-speed grinding wheel.

Construction:part and purpose

The grinding wheel performs the main stock removal.

A slower regulating wheel controls work rotation and, where inclined, axial through-feed.

A rigid work-rest blade supports work between the wheels.

Wheel slides set gap and geometry for the specified work size.

Guides support entry/exit alignment in through-feed work.

Dressing systems maintain wheel shape and active surface.

Guards, loading arrangements, coolant and controls manage ejection and contact hazards.

Working:flow and reason

An approved setup establishes wheel/blade geometry and work height.

The work is supported without centre holes on the rest blade.

Grinding-wheel rotation removes material at its contact zone.

The regulating wheel provides frictional control of work rotation.

In through-feed, regulating-wheel inclination gives an axial motion component.

In infeed, work is positioned for radial grinding rather than continuously passing through shoulders.

Approved inspection checks size and roundness; unstable geometry can produce lobing rather than a true circle.

Common mistake / conditions

Work-centre height is a controlled geometric setting, not an arbitrary placement; unsafe settings may eject work.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Work-rest blade,regulating wheel workpieceને high-speed grinding wheel સામે control કરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Grinding wheel main stock removal કરે.

Slower regulating wheel work rotation,અને inclined હોય ત્યારે axial through-feed control કરે.

Rigid work-rest blade wheels વચ્ચે work support કરે.

Wheel slides specified work size માટે gap,geometry set કરે.

Through-feedમાં guides entry/exit alignment support કરે.

Dressing systems wheel shape,active surface જાળવે.

Guards,loading arrangements,coolant,controls ejection/contact hazards સંભાળે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Approved setup wheel/blade geometry,work height establish કરે.

Work rest blade પર centre holes વગર support થાય.

Grinding-wheel rotation contact zoneમાં material દૂર કરે.

Regulating wheel frictionથી work rotation control કરે.

Through-feedમાં regulating-wheel inclination axial motion component આપે.

Infeedમાં work radial grinding માટે position થાય;shoulders સતત through-pass નથી થતાં.

Approved inspection size,roundness તપાસે;unstable geometryથી true circleની જગ્યાએ lobing થાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Work-centre height controlled geometric setting છે,arbitrary નહિ;unsafe settingથી work eject થાય.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Adjustable fixtures orient a tool against a suitable wheel to restore specified edge geometry.

Construction:part and purpose

Rigid base and table support precise tool/wheel positioning.

Wheelhead accepts a compatible rated wheel profile.

Angular/swivel settings establish the required rake/relief relationships.

Toolholders, centres or collets locate the tool shank/axis.

Indexing fixtures or tooth rests locate successive cutter teeth.

Fine feeds control small stock removal without destroying geometry.

Guards, dressing, extraction/coolant and measurement provisions support safe edge restoration.

Working:flow and reason

Identify the tool material and required geometry from an approved drawing/reference.

Select a compatible wheel and fixture under trained supervision.

Locate the tool repeatably and establish the required orientation.

Wheel rotation supplies abrasive cutting action.

Controlled feeds restore the selected face/edge with minimal material loss.

Indexing presents equivalent teeth while maintaining their relationship.

Inspect angles, edge condition and uniformity after safe stopping; avoid overheating.

Common mistake / conditions

Sharpening is not just making an edge look pointed; incorrect relief/rake can make the cutter rub or fail.
body.gu:

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Wheel rotation abrasive cutting action આપે.

Controlled feeds minimal lossથી selected face/edge restore કરે.

Indexingથી equivalent teeth આવે,relation જળવાય.

Safe stop પછી angles,edge condition,uniformity inspect કરો;overheating ટાળો.

Sharpening ફક્ત pointed દેખાવ નહિ;wrong relief/rakeથી cutter rub/fail થાય.

body.en:
Definition / principle

The abrasive cuts; the bond holds grains and controls their release.

Understand why

Aluminium oxide is widely used for many steels; silicon carbide suits many cast-iron/non-ferrous/nonmetal applications with proper grade selection.

CBN suits selected hardened ferrous materials; diamond suits many carbides, ceramics and non-ferrous materials, but hot iron can attack diamond.

Vitrified bonds offer rigidity/porosity in suitable wheels; resinoid bonds provide other strength/compliance characteristics.

Rubber, shellac, silicate and metal bonds serve particular duties; choose by wheel-maker application/rating rather than bond name alone.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Abrasive cut કરે;bond grains પકડે અને release control કરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Aluminium oxide ઘણા steelsમાં;silicon carbide proper gradeથી ઘણા cast-iron/non-ferrous/nonmetal applicationsમાં.

CBN selected hardened ferrousમાં;diamond ઘણા carbides,ceramics,non-ferrousમાં,પણ hot iron diamondને અસર કરે.

Suitable wheelમાં vitrified bond rigidity/porosity આપે;resinoidમાં strength/compliance જુદાં હોય.

Rubber,shellac,silicate,metal bonds particular duties માટે;ફક્ત નામ નહિ,wheel-maker application/rating મુજબ લો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A wheel specification separates abrasive, grain size, grade, structure and bond.

Understand why

A denotes aluminium oxide in this example; 46 denotes a grain-size class.

K denotes wheel grade:strength of grain retention by the bond, not the hardness of aluminium-oxide crystals.

5 denotes a structure designation; more open structure provides more chip space under the applicable system.

V denotes vitrified bond in this conventional marking; prefixes/suffixes may encode manufacturer details.

Dimensions, wheel type, maximum operating speed and expiry/storage instructions where applicable are separate essential information.

Does K mean abrasive hardness?

No. It is the wheel-grade/grain-retention designation in this example.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Wheel specification abrasive,grain size,grade,structure,bondને અલગ દર્શાવે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

આ exampleમાં A aluminium oxide;46 grain-size class દર્શાવે.

K wheel grade છે:bondની grain-retention strength,aluminium-oxide crystalની hardness નહિ.

5 structure designation છે;applicable systemમાં more open structure વધુ chip space આપે.

Conventional markingમાં V vitrified bond;prefix/suffix manufacturer details આપી શકે.

Dimensions,wheel type,maximum operating speed,applicable expiry/storage instructions અલગ જરૂરી માહિતી છે.

K એટલે Abrasive Hardness?

ના.આ exampleમાં wheel-grade/grain-retention designation છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Choose for material, stock, contact area, finish, machine and coolant conditions together.

Understand why

Coarser grit commonly gives more chip space and removal; finer grit favours finish within heat/loading limits.

Harder work often needs a softer wheel grade so dull grains release; softer work may allow a harder grade. This is a guideline, not a universal law.

Large contact area or gummy chips can require an open structure and suitable dressing to limit loading/heat.

Bond, wheel shape, speed rating and side-grinding permission must match the actual machine and operation.

Record the maker recommendation and actual constraints; do not select from work hardness alone.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Material,stock,contact area,finish,machine,coolant conditions સાથે પસંદ કરો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Coarser gritમાં સામાન્ય રીતે chip space,removal વધુ;finer grit heat/loading limitsમાં finish માટે.

Harder workમાં dull grains છૂટે તે માટે softer grade;softer workમાં harder grade ચાલે.આ guideline છે,universal law નહિ.

Large contact area,gummy chipsમાં loading/heat માટે open structure,suitable dressing જોઈએ.

Bond,shape,speed rating,side-grinding permission actual machine,operation સાથે match થવાં જોઈએ.

Maker recommendation,actual constraints નોંધો;ફક્ત work hardnessથી પસંદગી નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Separate a clogged surface, a dull surface and an inaccurate wheel shape.

Understand why

Loading is work/chip material packed in wheel pores, restricting effective cutting and chip space.

Glazing is dull grains retained at the surface that rub rather than cut effectively.

Truing corrects wheel geometry/profile and concentricity; dressing restores an open, sharp cutting surface.

One suitable operation may both true and dress, but the objectives remain distinct.

Use the correct dresser and approved protected method; an operator must not improvise contact with a running wheel.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Clogged surface,dull surface,wrong wheel shape અલગ સમજો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Loading એટલે poresમાં work/chips ભરાવાં,cutting/chip space ઘટે.

Glazingમાં dull grains surface પર રહી efficient cutની જગ્યાએ rub કરે.

Truing geometry/profile,concentricity સુધારે;dressing open,sharp cutting surface restore કરે.

એક suitable operation બન્ને કામ કરે,પણ objectives જુદાં રહે.

Correct dresser,approved protected method લો;running wheel સાથે improvised contact ન કરો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Wheel damage or overspeed can cause a dangerous burst; trained authorised setup is mandatory.

Understand why

Check identity, dimensions, rating, storage condition and visible damage against machine requirements; reject questionable wheels.

Use the maker-prescribed inspection/test method. Ring testing is only for appropriate wheel types and is not a universal proof of safety.

Isolate energy for mounting; use correct matched flanges/blotters where required and specified tightening—never force an unsuitable bore.

Balancing reduces mass-related vibration; truing fixes geometry. These are not substitutes for each other.

Confirm actual spindle speed does not exceed wheel rating; use the correct guard and approved protected verification procedure.

Never side-grind on a wheel not rated for it; avoid unguarded operation and unsafe contact during rotation.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Damage,overspeedથી dangerous burst થાય;trained authorised setup જરૂરી છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Identity,dimensions,rating,storage,visible damage machine requirement સામે તપાસો;questionable wheel reject કરો.

Maker-prescribed inspection/test લો.Ring test ફક્ત appropriate wheel types માટે;universal safety proof નહિ.

Mounting માટે energy isolate;correct matched flanges/blotters,required tightening લો;unsuitable bore force ન કરો.

Balancing mass-related vibration ઘટાડે;truing geometry સુધારે.એકબીજાના substitutes નથી.

Actual spindle speed wheel ratingથી ઉપર ન હોવી જોઈએ;correct guard,approved protected verification લો.

Side-grinding-rated ન હોય તે wheel પર side-grind નહિ;unguarded operation,rotationમાં unsafe contact ટાળો.

h.en: 6.2.6 Wheel surface speed and RPM rating
h.gu: 6.2.6 Wheel Surface Speed અને RPM Rating

body.en:
Given and model

Wheel diameter300mm, running N1800rev/min; hypothetical marked limit35m/s.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Vs=pi DN/60000=pi×300×1800/60000=28.2743m/s
  2. Nlimit from35m/s=60000×35/(pi×300)=2228.169rev/min

Common mistake / conditions

This arithmetic does not authorise operation. The actual marked RPM limit, machine limits, wheel condition, mounting and guard govern; do not round up beyond a rating.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Wheel diameter300mm,N1800rev/min;hypothetical marked limit35m/s.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Vs=pi DN/60000=pi×300×1800/60000=28.2743m/s
  2. Nlimit from35m/s=60000×35/(pi×300)=2228.169rev/min

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ ગણતરી operationની permission નથી.Actual marked RPM,machine limits,condition,mounting,guard નિર્ણાયક છે;ratingથી ઉપર round up ન કરો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Bonded abrasive stones contact a prepared surface, commonly a bore, with combined rotation and reciprocation.

Understand why

A honing head carries stones that act radially against the bore.

Combined motions create the characteristic crossed lay when the process is set accordingly.

Small stock removal can improve size, straightness/roundness within process capability and functional surface texture.

Cylinder bores are a common application; honing is not an excuse for incorrect initial hole location or excessive stock.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Bonded abrasive stones prepared surface,સામાન્ય રીતે bore,સાથે rotation,reciprocationથી contact કરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Honing headના stones bore સામે radially કામ કરે.

યોગ્ય process settingમાં combined motions characteristic crossed lay બનાવે.

Small removalથી capabilityમાં size,straightness/roundness,functional texture સુધરે.

Cylinder bores common application;wrong initial location,excessive stockને honingથી બધું સુધરી જાય એવું નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Loose abrasive between a lap and the work removes very small amounts by controlled relative motion.

Understand why

The lap is a carrier/counterface; abrasive slurry/paste acts at the interface.

Flat gauges, sealing faces and selected precision surfaces use lapping when process capability suits.

Control cleanliness, abrasive size, pressure and motion to avoid embedded grit or edge rounding.

High finish does not automatically guarantee correct flatness or dimensions; inspection remains essential.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Lap,work વચ્ચે loose abrasive controlled relative motionથી બહુ થોડું material દૂર કરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Lap carrier/counterface છે;slurry/paste interface પર કામ કરે.

Suitable capabilityમાં flat gauges,sealing faces,precision surfaces માટે lapping.

Embedded grit,edge rounding ટાળવા cleanliness,abrasive size,pressure,motion control કરો.

High finishથી correct flatness/dimensionsની guarantee નથી;inspection જરૂરી છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A fine bonded abrasive stone makes short oscillations against an already finished moving surface.

Understand why

Superfinishing removes surface peaks with very small stock removal; bearings/shafts are common applications.

Honing commonly combines rotation/reciprocation with stones; lapping uses loose abrasive; superfinishing uses fine stones with short oscillation.

Choose by initial geometry, required texture, dimensional correction and economics—not by calling every smooth surface lapped.

Finishing processes need controlled prior allowances and cleanliness; they do not replace gross machining.

Which process uses loose abrasive in its ordinary form?

Lapping; honing and superfinishing commonly use bonded abrasive stones.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Fine bonded abrasive stone already finished moving surface સામે short oscillations કરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Superfinishing બહુ નાના removalથી surface peaks દૂર કરે;bearing/shaftમાં common use.

Honingમાં stonesથી rotation/reciprocation;lappingમાં loose abrasive;superfinishingમાં fine stone,short oscillation.

Initial geometry,texture,dimensional correction,economicsથી પસંદ કરો;દરેક smooth surfaceને lapped ન કહો.

Finishingમાં controlled prior allowance,cleanliness જોઈએ;gross machiningના substitutes નથી.

Ordinary Formમાં Loose Abrasive કયું વાપરે?

Lapping;honing,superfinishingમાં સામાન્ય રીતે bonded stones હોય.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A shiny surface can still contain thermal damage, residual stress or dimensional error.

Understand why

Grinding burn, cracks and distortion can follow excess heat or unsuitable cutting condition.

Check wheel condition, holding, coolant delivery where used, feed and stock rather than hiding a problem with extra spark-out.

An exam answer should show wheel/work motions, holding, feeds and the distinct function of a regulating wheel or magnetic chuck where applicable.

Practical reports require actual machine data and inspection evidence; this learning package does not claim a physical grinding test.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Shiny surfaceમાં પણ thermal damage,residual stress,dimensional error હોઈ શકે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Excess heat,unsuitable conditionથી grinding burn,cracks,distortion થાય.

Problemને extra spark-outથી છુપાવ્યા વગર wheel,holding,coolant,feed,stock તપાસો.

Examમાં wheel/work motions,holding,feeds,applicable regulating wheel/magnetic chuckનું function બતાવો.

Practical reportમાં actual machine data,inspection evidence જોઈએ;આ package physical grinding testનો દાવો નથી.

h.en: 6.3.5 Grit, grade and structure:three different choices

body.en:
Definition / principle

Changing one field of a wheel specification does not necessarily change the other two.

Understand why

Fine grit means smaller abrasive grains under the specified grading system; it does not mean a softer bond.

A softer grade releases grains more readily; it does not make a hard abrasive crystal physically soft.

Open structure describes more space between grains/bond; it is not a lower spindle-speed setting.

For an exam, decode these separately before explaining their combined influence on loading, heat, removal and finish.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Wheel specificationની એક field બદલવાથી બાકીની બે બદલાય તે જરૂરી નથી.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Specified grading systemમાં fine grit એટલે નાના grains;softer bond નહિ.

Softer grade grainsને સહેલાઈથી release કરે;hard abrasive crystalને physically soft બનાવતું નથી.

Open structure grains/bond વચ્ચે વધુ જગ્યા દર્શાવે;lower spindle-speed setting નહિ.

Examમાં પહેલાં અલગ decode કરો,પછી loading,heat,removal,finish પર combined influence સમજાવો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A final grinding pass without additional commanded infeed may reduce elastic effects, but it cannot repair every defect.

Understand why

Spark-out allows residual contact/elastic recovery to remove a small remaining amount; use only a suitable approved process.

Thermal expansion can make an in-process dimension differ from a cooled inspection dimension.

Roundness, taper, flatness, roughness and surface integrity are distinct requirements; one micrometer reading cannot prove them all.

If burn, cracks, chatter or insecure holding is suspected, stop safely and investigate rather than continuing to polish the evidence away.

Does a shiny surface prove no grinding burn?

No. Surface integrity needs appropriate inspection, not appearance alone.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Additional commanded infeed વગર final grinding pass elastic effects ઘટાડે,પણ દરેક defect સુધારે નહિ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Spark-outમાં residual contact/elastic recoveryથી નાનું remaining removal થાય;suitable approved process જ લો.

Thermal expansionથી in-process dimension,cooled inspection dimension જુદાં હોય.

Roundness,taper,flatness,roughness,surface integrity જુદાં requirements;એક micrometer readingથી બધું સાબિત નહિ.

Burn,cracks,chatter,insecure holdingની શંકા હોય તો safely stop,investigate કરો;polish કરીને evidence છુપાવો નહિ.

Shiny Surfaceથી Grinding Burn નથી તે સાબિત?

ના.Surface integrity માટે appropriate inspection જોઈએ,ફક્ત દેખાવ નહિ.
